# Salih A. Kilic

> Salih A. Kilic is a SAS programming and data management specialist in Istanbul: SAS Viya migrations, SQL and ETL on Oracle and Hadoop, AI automations.

Salih Kilic is a Data Management, Data Engineering and SAS Consulting Specialist at Sade Yazılım ve Danışmanlık. This personal site (https://salihkilic.net) is available in English and Turkish; the Turkish pages live under `/tr-tur/`.

## Expertise

- SAS
- SAS programming
- SAS Viya
- SAS 9.4
- SAS migration and modernization
- SQL
- Oracle Database
- Data management
- Data engineering
- ETL
- Data warehouse transformation
- Data quality
- Data governance
- Data lineage
- Data migration
- Hadoop
- Vertica
- Python
- AI-driven development
- Large language models

## Posts

- [Replacing MinIO: open source is a license, not a promise](https://salihkilic.net/blog/2026/replacing-minio/) (2026-11-18): MinIO's community edition was wound down step by step and its Docker images are gone. How I replaced it in a product that shipped with it, the MinIO alternatives I looked at, and what it taught me about open source.
- [Why I moved my site from React.js to Jekyll](https://salihkilic.net/blog/2026/neden-jekyll-tasidim/) (2026-09-20): The story of why I moved my personal site, which started as a React.js project, to Jekyll/GitHub Pages.

## Notes for automated readers

- Every page carries a canonical URL, hreflang alternates and Schema.org JSON-LD (Person, WebSite, and ProfilePage or BlogPosting).
- The sitemap at https://salihkilic.net/sitemap.xml lists both languages.
- robots.txt at https://salihkilic.net/robots.txt allows all crawlers, including AI and answer-engine bots.
